head: LOG YOUR
WINS FROM
<g>DAY ONE.</g>
hacks: You will forget minor wins by the time your probation review arrives.
Open a private document named Work Log on your laptop today.
Big projects are built from small tasks that are easy to miss later.
Spend five minutes every Friday writing three things you finished.
Praise from colleagues proves your skills when appraisal time comes.
Screenshot praise on Teams and save the images in a folder.
Specific results make your internal reviews much stronger.
Note figures like "handled 15 client tickets in one morning".
Managers respect graduates who bring clear evidence to catch-ups.
Pick two items from your log to talk about in your next meeting.
out: Save this for your new job
Send it to a fellow graduate
